items.title: Daily Energy Pulse
items.description: Designed and deployed an on-demand newsletter system. Users subscribe via Tally, triggering a webhook that activates an AI workflow to generate daily email analysis of renewable energy news.

deepDive.heading: The Solution
deepDive.content:
To put this knowledge into practice, I designed and deployed an on-demand newsletter system. Users subscribe via a <tally>Tally</tally> web interface, triggering a webhook that activates an automated AI workflow.

The system autonomously generates a daily email featuring a concise analysis of the latest renewable energy news, a "Winners & Losers" market assessment, and strategic recommendations for industry professionals.

This initiative was inspired by my own routine of consuming executive financial briefings; I wanted to replicate that efficiency, creating a solution that allows users to stay updated on complex energy trends in just a few minutes every morning.

items.title: Smart Lead Clipper
items.description: B2B Prospecting Automation. A tool that eliminates administrative friction, allowing users to focus on finding leads, not data entry. Connected LinkedIn → Gemini AI → Notion.

deepDive.heading: The Problem
deepDive.content: In sales, time is the most valuable asset. However, SDRs and sales reps waste hours on low-value administrative tasks: copying names, switching tabs, and manually pasting data into CRMs.

deepDive.heading: My Objective
deepDive.content: To build a tool that eliminates administrative friction, allowing users to focus on finding and qualifying leads, not data entry.

deepDive.heading: The Workflow
deepDive.content: The system connects LinkedIn → Gemini AI → Notion. It captures lead data from LinkedIn profiles, enriches it with AI-powered analysis, and automatically organizes it in a structured Notion database — all in one click.

items.title: Strategic Benchmarking
items.description: Automated Financial Benchmarking. A pipeline that eliminates administrative friction, allowing users to focus on analyzing financial performance rather than manual data entry. Connected OneDrive → Gemini AI → Google Sheets → Power BI.

deepDive.heading: The Problem
deepDive.content: Financial benchmarking is traditionally a slow, bureaucratic process. Analysts spend hours scouring annual reports and manually updating spreadsheets—valuable time that should be spent on high-level strategic decision-making and market positioning.

deepDive.heading: My Objective
deepDive.content: To build an automated pipeline that eliminates administrative friction, allowing users to focus on analyzing financial performance and taking strategic action rather than performing manual data entry.

deepDive.heading: The Workflow
deepDive.content: The system connects OneDrive → Gemini AI → Google Sheets → Power BI. It captures financial reports uploaded to the cloud, uses AI to intelligently extract key metrics (Revenue Growth, Net Margin, Inventory Turnover), and visualizes Inditex's position against its main competitors in a dynamic dashboard.

deepDive.heading: The Value
deepDive.content: This tool shifts the focus from 'paperwork' to 'insights.' By instantly comparing Inditex's profitability and efficiency against market leaders, we can identify strategic gaps in real-time. The system is fully scalable, making it easy to add or discard competitors. Shifting the focus from bureaucracy to action.
